_help: brain-signer config (signer/brain_signer.py), the other end of brain-kit's sign.SpoolSigner (the app's bridge.json "signer": {"type": "spool", "spool_dir": <spool>, "allowed_signers": ...}). Runs as its own OS user (brainbridge); this file, the signing key, its GitLab token and its identities copy are readable by that user only. pseudonym_salt must equal the app's bridge.json pseudonym_salt. Answers are signed only when the project's .brain/kit.json on the default branch names bridge_user (the GitLab account of the app's bridge token). bridge_users is optional: a pin, kit.json's bridge_user must be one of them. Needs brain-kit c9e59d1 or newer.
